content: Teewadi Rangte sengte sengwah loong damdi ja hantek dook roong waanta erah damdi hejaat hejaat lam ih khowah loong jun ih roong waanta,
Enoothong amadi bah heh Sah jun ih waan hali. Rangte ih rang ah hah ah heh jun ih dongsiitta, Hethoon doh jirep ah Rangte ih heh lak nah kot suh juujeeta.

Rangte chaan aphaan ah heh ih ngaak phaak took ha eno heh Rangte ah mamah angla erah likhiikkhiik angla, heh chaan aphaan jengkhaap nawa ih rang ah hah thoontang thingtong thukla. Mina loong rangdah biin anaan mootkaat ah jen moh ano, rangmong ni Elongthoon Chaan aphaan Rangte dakchah ko adi tong wangta.
Rangte Sah ah rangsah thaknang ibah elong hoonta, heh men ah Rangte ih neng thaknang ibah elong ih thinta,
Mamah liidih Rangte ih heh rangsah loong wasiit suh uh baat muh,

content.text: “An nga Sah ngeh ah;
chiinnyah ngah an Wah eh hoon lang.”

content: Marah Rangsah tiit uh ebaat muh

content.text: “Ngah heh suh heh wah ang ang,
eno heh ah nga sah ang ah.”

content: Enoothong Rangte ih heh sah miwasah tupkhoh ah mongrep nah daapkaat suh liita tok adi, heh ih liita,

content.text: “Rangte rangsah thoontang ih heh ah soomtu theng.”

content: Enoothong rangsah loong tiit ah Rangte ih liita,

content.text: “Rangsah loong ah Rangte ih pongbih ih hoon thuk rumta,
eno heh laksuh loong ah weeluung ih hoon thuk rumta.”

content: Mamah ang abah uh Rangte ih miwasah tiit asuh baatta:

content.text: “O Rangte, an hasong ah timtok doh uh lathoon theng toom ang ah!
An mina loong ah epun lam ih pan rum uh.
An ih kateng ah minchan ehu eno ethih ah miksuk ehu.
Erah raangtaan ih an Rangte ih danje taho
eno esoomtu ih taho raangtaan ih rapne thoon roon thuk halu
an damdoh wa loong asuh kot thaknang ibah an suh koh halu.”
“An, Teesu, rangphang di hatoh hoontu,
eno an laklak ih rangmong loong ah hoontu.
Neng tikmat eh ah, enoothong an heh phoopho ang uh;
Neng ah nyuh akhat tuungkhaang arah likhiik ih thi rum ah.
An ibah kut kakok thin ajih kok thin uh,
eno neng ibah nyuh kah lek ajih lek rum ah,
Enoothong an abah saarookwe erarah ang uh,
eno an roidong ah timtok doh uh tah thoonka.”

content: Rangte ih marah rangsah loong suh uh tah baatta:

content.text: “Nga dakchah ko adoh tong wangho
an lathong nah anpi anra loong ah
an lah naktheng maang thinthin ah.”

content: Enoobah rangsah loong ah timjih ah? Neng loong ah chiiala loong Rangte mootkaatte eno neng ih khopiiroidong chote loong huinong roonghui suh daapkaat taha.
